problems_and_friction: No friction encountered. pack-html argument order was already known from hop-01 receipt — positional order (PARENT then HTML) was used correctly on first attempt.
Output schema is still a bare 'type: object' with no field constraints — analyst has full discretion on data shape. This is consistent with hop-01 findings.
The TOON-encoded data from hop-01 was easy to read and provided all necessary market context without re-running extra commands.
The hop-01 receipt explicitly documented the argument order error, which prevented repeating it — the receipt handoff mechanism worked as intended.
context_understood: Hop 2 of 3 in a multi-agent market entry assessment pipeline for Brightline Logistics entering the German logistics market. Hop 1 (market-size analyst) produced TAM/SAM analysis (€127bn TAM, €31bn SAM, 4.2% CAGR), competitive landscape, and recommended Warehousing & Fulfillment + Last-Mile as entry segment with 22-month break-even. Role as Hop 2 is risk analyst: assess entry risks across five categories (regulatory, competitive, operational, financial, macroeconomic), produce risk matrix, enumerate specific risks with mitigations, and provide a structured handoff to the synthesizer (Hop 3). Output mode: full-html using pack-html with YAML frontmatter for structured data.
